about_short_description.short_description: Skyvern is an AI based Automate browser that helps with complex workflows using AI agents.

product.name: AI Browser Automation
product.description: An AI-driven platform that automates browser-based workflows by adapting to any webpage using computer vision and natural language commands, enabling execution of complex tasks and scaling via API.

product.name: Contact Forms Agent
product.description: An AI agent that automates outbound submissions of browser-based contact forms at scale, handling thousands of leads concurrently without email infrastructure setup.

product.name: Live Jobs Agent
product.description: An AI agent that automates online job applications by submitting resumes and user information to multiple job portals using provided URLs.

product.name: Beta Invoices Agent
product.description: An AI agent that downloads invoices from vendor portals, including those requiring login credentials, based on user-defined criteria.

product.name: Training Purchasing Agent
product.description: An AI agent that automates secure online purchasing by processing product lists and payment details to complete transactions.

product.name: Training Government Agent
product.description: An AI agent that automates filling out government forms by using user-supplied information to complete multi-step workflows.
